items.reason: Out-of-segment fact (automotive / eVTOL inverter gate driver, sampling only) on the HVDC data-center power placement; per the 2026-10-12 rule it carries no slot, and a sample-availability notice should not replace the company's call-based next_catalyst (screener is per company).
